يحتقبا (form VIII)
# يَحْتَقِبَا (yaḥtaqibā) /jaħ.ta.qi.baː/: third-person masculine dual non-past active subjunctive/jussive of اِحْتَقَبَ (iḥtaqaba)
# يُحْتَقَبَا (yuḥtaqabā) /juħ.ta.qa.baː/: third-person masculine dual non-past passive subjunctive/jussive of اِحْتَقَبَ (iḥtaqaba)
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
